latency_ms.scope: in-process search only; excludes process startup and index construction

limitations: The 105-query set contains 35 Codex-authored intent clusters and has no human-reviewed labels.
RRF k=60 and candidate depth are untuned defaults, not optimized on a held-out set.
Qdrant local mode and an in-process embedding model do not represent service latency.
Thread timeouts stop waiting but cannot terminate already-running provider calls; provider-native timeouts remain required in production.
No metadata filters, query rewrite, or reranker are applied in this hybrid baseline.
No statistical significance or generalization claim is made.
